findings.F1: The book fails on drawdown, not on fees. Calmar is 0.50, below the 0.75 required. Each coin's worst drawdown runs from -46% (BTC) to -70% (ZEC, XRP), and the mean drawdown per window is -23.7%. Over 2,285 trades, fees average 0.10% against a mean gross gain of 5.19%, and the total fees paid (234) are 2% of the total gross gain (11,857).
findings.F2: The forecast has no measurable edge at the 20-bar horizon. On active bars, the forward 20-bar excess return is +1.5% with t=0.63 over 251 non-overlapping cases, and the forecast>2.5 bucket gives +1.45% with t=0.59 over 242 cases. A larger forecast does not earn more: the four entry-forecast quartiles average a gross gain of 6.2%, 4.3%, 2.3% and 7.8% per trade.
findings.F3: The book is a lottery on a few long trends.
findings.F4: The edge sits where the 60-bar trend is also up.
findings.F5: Keeping only active days with a positive 60-bar return cuts the mean drawdown per window from -23.7% to -14.2%, while the annualised mean falls only from 0.38 to 0.29.
findings.F6: Volatile states add drawdown without adding drift.

ideas.idea: A coin that closes above its 200-day average with a positive 20-bar return keeps rising faster than its own average over the next 20 bars mainly when its 60-bar return is also positive, that is, when the short rise belongs to an older, established up-trend.
ideas.consequence: Take the trend long only when the 60-bar return is also up, and refuse fresh bounces inside a falling quarter.
ideas.name: established trend confirms persistence

ideas.idea: A coin above its rising long average drifts upward over the next 20 bars more when its recent 20-day volatility is low relative to its own history.
ideas.consequence: Refuse or shrink trend longs when the coin's recent daily swings are in its high range, since they add drawdown without adding drift.
ideas.name: calm trends persist better

ideas.idea: A coin whose close has stayed above its 200-day average with a positive 20-bar return on most of the last 20 bars keeps rising over the next 20 bars, while a coin that has only just entered that state tends to fall back out of it.
ideas.consequence: Enter the trend long only once the up state has held for a while, rather than on its first day, to avoid the many short losing spells.
ideas.name: persistent state, not fresh entry
